summary: Separate native ConstraintElasticConnector with explicit unit-aware total stiffness, global CAD-vertex identity, local axis/rotation/reference, native suppression and ordinary CalculiX regeneration. Existing Elmer foundation Spring remains unchanged; attempting to use that unconsumed feature in CalculiX now gives an explicit error.
supported_scope: Scalar linear translational SPRING1/SPRING2, one mesh node to ground or two distinct mesh nodes, in3D small-displacement static analysis. No area distribution, rotation/torsion, rigid/tie substitution, guessed Kser or equivalent stiffness.
scope_validation: Reject dynamic/frequency,2D, geometric nonlinearity and active nonlinear material laws. The default 'use nonlinear properties if available' flag alone does not make an otherwise linear model unsupported. Z88/Mystran/Elmer reject active native connectors rather than silently omit them.
gui: Native FEM toolbar/menu command 'Elastic Connector (CalculiX)' prefills one/two selected vertices, selects the new object for Data editing, supports Undo/Redo, rejects invalid selections and leaves Stiffness at invalid zero until supplied explicitly. Native property-editor visibility was asserted and visually checked.

exact_cases: Ground and two-node springs with0/90degree local frames, prescribed displacement or applied10N. For K2000N/mm, free displacement is0.005mm.

Prescribed two-node displacement0.1/-0.05mm gives raw holding actions+300/-300N along the selected direction; ground0.1mm gives200N. These are isolated spring nodes, not a claim that arbitrary assembly nodal RF isolates a connector force.
Negative imposed displacements and localY/Z verify signed opposite actions, not magnitudes only.
Changing End2 from a node at-0.05mm to a fixed block vertex regenerates the actual spring and changes actions from300/-300N to200/-200N.
Split-input ground force case gives the same exact0.005mm displacement without editing either generated file.
Explicit parallel2000+3000N/mm ground connectors give10/(2000+3000)=0.002mm, with no automatic stiffness division.

user_usage: In the new build, activate a FEM analysis, select one CAD vertex (ground) or two (pair), run Elastic Connector (CalculiX), enter justified Stiffness in Data, and set the local Axis/Orientation/OrientationReference. Each endpoint must map to one mesh node. Regenerate with stock CalculiX. This command is not yet in the installed +144 app.
result_limit: Endpoint U and RF are raw global nodal outputs. With other connected elements, RF is not generally a separated spring force; no custom result recovery was added.
